mechanics.claim: Basic attacks on-hit and Vault Breaker apply a stack of Denting Blows, refreshing duration on subsequent applications up to 3 stacks.
mechanics.quote: '''Vi's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} and ''{{ai|Vault Breaker|Vi}}'' apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Denting Blows'' to enemies hit for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and stacking up to 3 times

mechanics.claim: The third stack consumes all stacks to deal bonus physical damage and apply armor reduction.
mechanics.quote: The third stack consumes them all to deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}, capped at 300 against non-champions, and inflict {{sti|armor penetration|{{as|20% armor reduction}}}} for 4 seconds

mechanics.claim: The armor penetration applies after the triggering damage instance.
mechanics.quote: The armor penetration will apply after the triggering damage.

mechanics.claim: The triggering attack applies other on-hit effects and can critically strike, but the bonus damage itself cannot crit or lifesteal.
mechanics.quote: The enhanced attack applies other {{tip|on-hit}} effects and can both {{tip|critical strike|critically strike}} as normal as well as apply {{sti|life steal|link=true}} (the bonus damage cannot do either).

mechanics.claim: Denting Blows can be blocked but cannot be dodged nor missed while Vi is blinded.
mechanics.quote: ''Denting Blows'' can be {{tip|blocked}} but cannot be {{tip|dodged}} nor missed while '''Vi''' is {{tip|blind|blinded}}.

mechanics.claim: The attacks do not affect structures or wards.
mechanics.quote: The attacks do not affect {{tip|structures}} nor {{tip|wards}}.

mechanics.claim: After consuming Denting Blows, Vi gains bonus attack speed which refreshes on subsequent triggers.
mechanics.quote: After consuming ''Denting Blows'', '''Vi''' gains {{sti|as|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for 4 seconds, which refreshes on subsequent triggers.
